name: Vent integrations
ownerWords:
an IMPORTANT feature of vent is to check, notify whether each integration is active (especially the flaky ones). have a green light thing, track stats success percent, and alert when failure rates increase

make it work if there are any issues discovered, or there are quirks like bad call stack, unreliable shit, throughput issues when scaled

verify locally, deploy to staging & prod.
goal: Prod Vent calls succeed at least 99% of the time over 24 h, not counting the caller's own 4xx, both Vent hosts answer 200 on /healthz, no integration shows a red light on the prod console, and prod Vent never runs an older build than staging for more than a day. These are the problems that kept coming back in the vent chat: prod upstream 429 and 5xx failures kept success at 94.6 to 98% on all 40 Vent gateway runs since 10-18 22:04Z; expired or invalid provider credentials hit 6 times (the Stripe test key, the Instagram token, prod Resend's 403, Clerk's server-side token, an encrypted Convex webhook secret, customer-token 401s); CLIProxy 502s and Claude model fallbacks hit 4 times; and failed lands and promotes held prod Vent on an old build 11 times from 10-18 to 10-19 (lands 39, 40, 43, 46, 48, 49, 50, 51 and 54's staging deploy, promotes 12 and 14). The precheck vent-integrations.ts builds the prod lights and the 24 h success with Vent's own vent.health code, the code behind the console's /_vent/admin/health, so a call counts as the console counts it: success and failure only, without the caller's own 4xx, the Claude account cap, refused and cancelled calls. Release lag runs from the later of prod first logging its /healthz build and staging last logging it, read from service.version on Vent's OTel rows. Each run also reads the Vent Grafana folder: a false alert gets its condition changed, and a problem no alert caught gets a new alert.

metrics.label: Prod Vent call success over 24 h, without the caller's own 4xx
Integrations with a red light on the prod Vent console
Hours prod Vent has run an older build than staging
Vent hosts not answering 200 on /healthz (prod and staging)

onMiss: Steer the live job on the fix step for the missed metric, or start one fix job when none is live, with the metric's name in its brief. vent_success_24h_pct under 99: read the call_failed rows and send the largest outcome by integration to the p25 job 'vent prod call failures'. vent_success_24h_pct at -1 means prod Vent took no calls in 24 h, which follows the hosts. red_integrations_prod above 0: read the red_light rows, or the prod console's lights when there are more than 3; an expired or invalid credential gets a new key into Vent's tier file and keeper store, or a For you todo only when the owner's own sign-in is needed, and a CLIProxy or upstream outage gets a retry or fallback fix in Vent. prod_vent_behind_staging_h above 24: the behind_staging row names both builds and since when; find the land or promote run that stopped, fix it when the cause is in Vent's code, and otherwise send the VP of CI the run id and the failed step in one message. vent_hosts_down above 0 (host_down rows): read the container logs on the box and redeploy Vent through the p23 job 'vent release driver'. A false alert in the Vent Grafana folder gets its condition changed, and a miss no alert caught gets a new rule. A source_error row means a source was not read, so fix the read first. No outside sends (c37). Merges, pushes and prod promotes need no go before the launch (c74). All on target: end the turn with no message.
